runtime.autocast: bfloat16 (upstream default on supported CUDA GPUs)

inference.scope: One full-source Aria-AMT inference with its own note/velocity/pedal estimates; no Transkun/Kong substitution or strings
inference.runtimeAdaptation: Use current Windows Python 3.12 / torch and torchaudio 2.11; author declares Python >=3.11 but pins torchaudio <=2.5. Replace legacy stream/file I/O and multiprocessing queues with miniaudio-decoded CPU arrays and a synchronous caller. Preserve upstream 30/10-second window/padding, mel transform, unmodified model, token generation, prefix reconciliation and MIDI detokenization. No compiler or int8 quantization. This is a local compatibility run, not a certified author benchmark.

renderSettings.tempo: Retain each recording's chosen audition tempo through MIDI-event timing; do not impose the Burgmuller tempo on other pieces or stretch rendered audio
renderSettings.loudnessStrategy: Constant gain only; retain safe peak headroom and note dynamics; no compressor or limiter

pianoPreset.verification: Confirm actual reverb in the output using a wet/dry comparison. Earlier Salamander A/B renders were effectively identical because no MIDI reverb send reached the effect. Check loudness matching, full decoding, headroom, quiet ending and retained credits before delivering an audition.
